positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationState
positions.frame: what constitutes the verified calibration state of the Kestrelwood spectrograph?
positions.why: src-1 is Quill's first-person assertion that the spectrograph is calibrated at 88.4 MHz and verified against June reference plates across the full observing band; src-2 is the declarative record of the same key decisions (instrument, calibration frequency, verification reference). Both expressions cohere under the directional read of what establishes and documents the calibration state — one as witness testimony, one as recorded decision summary.
